---
title: "Datasets"
subtitle: "What is released, by topic"
---

Each dataset gathers products on one theme, e.g. the geothermal heat flow maps of
several sources (GHF), on the grids of the domains where they apply. Topo and Regions
are made by their own pipelines on every domain, from the base grid to the coarsest
grid; the other gridded datasets are made by remapping published maps, on the grids
that their sources resolve (see [Precision and file sizes](precision.qmd)). The
[Records](records_overview.qmd) are non-gridded data (time series, sites, profiles).
The page of each dataset describes its products, their sources and licences, and lists
its files under Downloads; [Products](products.qmd) shows which dataset is on which
domain.
